extension.description: Show Tencent CodeBuddy credits / remaining quota in the VS Code status bar (auto-fetches the official usage API)
command.setCookie: CodeBuddy Usage: Set login credentials (Cookie + User-Agent)
command.setAccessToken: CodeBuddy Usage: Set Access Token (optional fallback)
config.title: CodeBuddy Usage
config.cookie: Login Cookie copied from the workbuddy.cn website (stored locally only). Legacy mode — only used when no Access Token is available
config.accessToken: Access Token (JWT) used as a fallback when the CodeBuddy sign-in state cannot be read automatically. Normally you do NOT need to set this: the extension reads it automatically and CodeBuddy keeps it refreshed. Stored locally only
config.userAgent: Browser User-Agent (stored locally only). Leave empty to use the built-in default Chrome/153. Must come from the same request as the Cookie, otherwise the server treats the session as mismatched and returns 401
config.refreshIntervalMinutes: Auto refresh interval (minutes), 0 disables auto refresh
config.autoCheckin: Enable automatic daily check-in to claim credits (when disabled, no check-in runs and the hover tooltip hides the check-in status)
config.buddyTravel: Enable buddy travel (send your buddy on tasks to earn credits automatically). When enabled, each refresh claims and dispatches the buddy automatically; the tooltip shows the travel countdown / claim / depart actions, once per day
